status: NOT CHANGED. Recorded as a limitation; the decision is deferred.
how_the_current_value_was_derived: max(DENSITY_GRID) * rsu_coverage_lane_km(), i.e. a FREE-FLOW capacity, raised from a literal 100 on the strength of a MEAN in-range count of 141.7 at density 35. The formula is not wrong; the condition it rests on -- that vehicles spread evenly over the coverage disc -- does not hold in this environment, where signals pack them.
road_dependence: Saturation depends strongly on WHICH ROAD. Over a single road (all densities reseeded to one value) the uncensored per-step maximum was 167, just under the cap and never touching it. Over the eight roads the collection spanned, density 20 was clipped in 6.62 % of rows and density 30 in 4.05 %. One road cannot answer the question.
raising_the_cap_is_not_free: n_active_norm currently has mean 0.734. Raising the cap to 250 would move that to about 0.49 and compress the spread: the clipping of 6.6 % of samples would be traded for reduced resolution across the other 93.4 %. Which side is better has NOT been established. Using the full [0,1] range is not itself the goal -- feature [14], the channel busy ratio, uses 2 % of its range and that is the physically correct value.
whether_clipping_is_even_harmful: Unestablished. Clipping loses information only if the optimal action differs between the clipped states. If 168 and 200 vehicles both mean 'heavily congested' and call for the same grant, the clip is harmless. This becomes answerable once a trained policy exists and its actions in that region can be inspected.
why_the_definitive_measurement_was_not_t: Setting the cap correctly requires measuring the tail over all FOURTEEN road cycles training visits. That was not done because road_seed(density, cycle) was being introduced at the same time and a measurement taken against the old scheme would have to be repeated. It is deferred, not overlooked; the resolution condition is 'after road_seed is settled, measure fourteen cycles'.

congestion_reduces_in_range_count_at_the.observation: density 30 peaks at 167 in-range vehicles while density 35 peaks at 154, on the same road.
congestion_reduces_in_range_count_at_the.reading: Congestion throttles inflow, so the count inside the coverage disc falls once the approaches saturate. This is a real property of traffic flow and its appearance here is evidence that the simulation computes vehicle interaction rather than assuming free flow. Worth stating in the simulation-setup section.
